rows.grounds: present passive participle of root chid
compound: tad (that) + gata (gone), describing one absorbed in that
bahuvrihi compound: tad (that) + manas (mind), whose mind is on that

items.question: Does absorption in that state prevent harm when the body is being cut?
premises: A person may be subjected to cutting.
That person has gone to that state.
That person's mind is fixed on that state.
items.inference: One absorbed in that state is not truly cut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' (tad) depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Just as one who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it, though being cut, is not cut.
